answer: By parameterizing the transition kernel of a personalized PageRank matrix, we enforce a spectral partition barrier that confines dishonest flows to an isolated Sybil island. Crucially, combining this topological bound with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function and slashing penalties for duplicated identities guarantees a negative expected utility for any attacker. Consequently, the economic nectar of honest validator rewards maintains a robust Nash equilibrium, driving asymptotic consensus convergence across the sparse graph cuts.
